title: ARC dataset v1.0: per-service damage of remediation actions in a microservice system
description: 1,795 controlled incidents on the Train Ticket microservice system (20 to 25 services, Kubernetes, Chaos Mesh faults). In each, one remediation action (no-op, restart-pod, rollout-restart, scale-up, cpu-bump, drain) is applied and the damage to every service is measured as the rise of its share of bad requests. Raw telemetry (per-service time series, call graph, exact counters, every user request), labels at three latency bars, six evaluation splits, calibration, a loader and a datasheet. Known issues (saturation, one system, one machine) are listed in DATASHEET.md.
